correctness.rationale: Derivation of the first RSAV step gives z1=(I-B/(1+eta))z, eta=z^T B z/(||z||^2+2C). For nonzero z the attenuation is strictly below one. The all-z energy criterion is B <= 2I; if violated, a top-eigenvector scaled to zero proves failure. Loewner inversion gives h(H-2L)<=2I. Courant-Fischer on ker L proves lambda_max(H-2L)>=lambda_{r+1}(H); a half-Hessian leading-rank truncation attains equality. Handles d=1, r=0 and exact boundary. Self-contained verifier ran 17663 recorded numerical checks; proof is analytic.
